tree: Send appointment reminders, follow-ups and notifications by SMS and email — automatically. Reduce no-shows and save time.

tree.aria-label: Noxtill reminder workflow: appointment booked, wait until 24 hours before, send SMS, then mark confirmed, send reschedule link or email backup

tree: How can a business automate appointment reminders?
Appointment reminder software sends a message by SMS or email at a set time before each appointment, so customers remember to come or can reschedule in time.
Customers forget appointments, and staff spend hours calling to remind them.
Reminders go out on their own at the time you choose, for every booking.
Appointment reminder software keeps every booking on track.
